purpose: Construct, using Reference only, a material-independent E0 state domain that remains inside the shared production state bounds across all 36 D3R materials before any new RossFast material-extension discrepancies are generated.

state_scan.rationale: 0.50-0.90 uses a regular 0.05 grid retaining the prior 0.65 and 0.85 anchors; 0.92-0.98 resolves the near-wet boundary implicated prospectively by P2E11D1.

temporal_schedule.rationale: Retains the P2E08 anchor schedule and the P2E11 best-tested extension level so this workunit changes the state axis rather than simultaneously changing state and temporal design.

matrix.reference_solves_per_case: one coarse plus two sequential half steps

common_state_definition.requirement: All 36 materials x both forcing classes pass Reference convergence, typed integrated mass, finite state, pressure-head domain and theta-domain checks on coarse and both half trajectories.
common_state_definition.theta_domain: theta_r < theta < theta_s for each material

future_anchor_selection_rule.dry_anchor: Common Se closest to 0.65; ties choose the lower Se.
future_anchor_selection_rule.intermediate_anchor: Common Se closest to 0.85 excluding the dry anchor; ties choose the lower Se.
future_anchor_selection_rule.interpretation: These become candidates for a later separately frozen calibration/admissibility experiment. P2E13 itself does not freeze solver-discrepancy thresholds.

known_prior_information.rule: They are not inputs to the state-domain algorithm. All 36 materials are evaluated only through the Reference route in P2E13.

outcome_policy.if_three_or_more_common_levels: Persist complete common-state set and the three rule-selected future anchors; next step is a separate Reference temporal/calibration freeze on those anchors.
outcome_policy.if_fewer_than_three_common_levels: Persist the negative state-domain result and stop broad 36-material paired extension design pending a narrower scientific question.
